parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
Filters instances by billing method. Valid values:

- PrePaid: subscription.

- PostPaid: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the resource group is located.

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: A keyword for the search. You can search by instance ID or IP address.

parameters.name: InstanceIP
parameters.description: The IP address of the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: Filter by instance ID. For more information, see [ListResourceInstances](~~412129~~).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of instances to return on each page. Default value: 100.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group. For more information, see [ListResources](~~412133~~).
